description: This Java class utility provides a method to determine the runtime class of a generic entity in a class hierarchy, particularly one that extends 'SalesManagerEntity'. It uses reflection to traverse superclasses and inspect generic type parameters.

classes.name: GenericEntityUtils
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for working with generic entity types using reflection, specifically to find classes extending SalesManagerEntity in a class hierarchy.

methods.name: getGenericEntityClassFromComponentDefinition
methods.description: Determines the Class object of the generic entity type that extends SalesManagerEntity from a given class, by traversing its superclass chain and analyzing generic type parameters.
